name: The Three Movements
summary: Stromy's core engagement model: Movement I — Read the room (process mapping); Movement II — Compose the system (build connectors/skills); Movement III — Conduct it in production (deployment).

name: The Stromy Model (Identify → Build → Embed)
summary: Identify where AI creates the highest leverage; build custom AI tools and automations; embed by transferring capability to the client's team — systems designed to be owned, not rented.

name: Engagement Phases
summary: Strategy Workshop (4–8 wks) → Solution Design (4–8 wks) → Implementation Sprint (12–16 wks) → Ongoing Partnership (retainer); plus an Incubator Package (8–12 wks) for solo consultants and boutique firms.

name: Rule of Three (Strategy Audit)
summary: A strategy-audit framework: 35 scored criteria, role-specific interview packs, AI-assembled evidentiary scoring with human override, producing a branded deliverable suite.
